description: Authenticated: create a new recurring paid watch for repeated research or monitoring. Each execution is a normal paid machine job bounded by max_price_cents plus the machine's delegated spending limits; cadence must be 60-10080 minutes. Use this only to create a new watch; use set_recurring_paid_watch to enable/disable an existing watch and submit_paid_machine_job for one-time work.

cadence_minutes.description: Minutes between scheduled runs. Minimum 60 minutes; maximum 10080 minutes (7 days).

constraints.description: Optional reusable execution constraints applied to every run, such as location, filters, maximum results, verification requirements, or exclusions.

max_price_cents.description: Maximum price in USD cents allowed for each individual run before the job is rejected rather than overspending.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for the watch.

query.description: The recurring research or monitoring request to execute on each scheduled run.

run_immediately.description: If true, request an initial run immediately after watch creation; if false or omitted, wait for the normal cadence.

task_type.description: Optional execution category used to route each run to a compatible worker; omit when the query itself is sufficient for routing.

name: create_recurring_paid_watch
